verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a questionnaire-automation product that generates answers from a knowledge base and lets teams review/approve/submit, plus API endpoints to manage responses on a Trust questionnaire, but no evidence specifically confirms import/export support for SIG, CAIQ, external portals, or arbitrary spreadsheet formats. Missing for 10: explicit format support (SIG/CAIQ templates), portal-based questionnaire ingestion, spreadsheet round-trip export, and any independent confirmation of multi-format fidelity.
